info.title: BleachVerse API Documentation
info.description: Comprehensive API endpoints for BleachVerse, exposing character, arc, episode, fight, organization, zanpakuto, and location resources.

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all characters with optional filtering and search.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort the results by

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive details for a single character using their unique URL-friendly slug.
Retrieve a paginated list of all story arcs with optional search and type filtering.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search arc by name or slug (case-insensitive substring)

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort the results by

200.description: A paginated list of story arcs

get.description: Retrieve details and coverage information for a single story arc by its unique slug.
Retrieve a paginated list of episodes belonging to a specific story arc.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Set to true to retrieve 100% of the episodes in the arc without pagination limits

200.description: A paginated list of episodes belonging to the arc

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of fights belonging to a specific story arc, ordered by title ascending.

200.description: A paginated list of fights belonging to the arc

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of events belonging to a specific story arc, ordered by title ascending.

200.description: A paginated list of events belonging to the arc

get.summary: Get distinct characters of an arc
get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of distinct characters appearing in the episodes of a specific story arc, ordered alphabetically by name.

200.description: A paginated list of distinct characters belonging to the arc

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all episodes with optional filtering by arc slug and episode type.

parameters.name: arcSlug
parameters.description: Filter episodes by parent Arc slug

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter episodes by type (CANON, FILLER, MIXED, RECAP)

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive details for a single episode using its unique episode number.
Retrieve comprehensive details for a single episode using its unique URL-friendly slug.
Retrieve a paginated list of fights with optional search and filters for type, winner, arc, and location.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter fights by type (DUEL, TEAM_BATTLE, WAR, TRAINING)

parameters.name: winnerSlug
parameters.description: Filter fights won by a specific character slug

parameters.name: arcSlug
parameters.description: Filter fights belonging to a specific story arc slug

parameters.name: locationSlug
parameters.description: Filter fights taking place in a specific location slug

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort the results by

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive details for a single fight including winner, participants, episode, arc, and location.
Retrieve a paginated list of all organizations with optional name search and type filtering.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort the results by

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive details for a single organization including parent organization, child divisions, and roster members.
Retrieve a paginated list of Zanpakutō weapons with optional search, type filtering, and wielder filtering.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by Zanpakutō type (NORMAL, DUAL, HYBRID)

parameters.name: wielderSlug
parameters.description: Filter Zanpakutō by wielder character slug

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Field to sort the results by
